stemMd: Two unaffected carriers of an autosomal recessive allele have a child known to be unaffected. Under complete penetrance, what is the probability that this child is a carrier?
explanationMd: The cross gives one dominant homozygote, two heterozygotes and one recessive homozygote in equal quarter units. Exclude the affected recessive homozygote: two of the remaining three units are carriers.

distractorRationale.a: This is the unconditional affected probability.
distractorRationale.b: This is the unconditional carrier probability before excluding affected children.
distractorRationale.d: This is the probability of being unaffected, not carrier conditional on that.
distractorRationale.e: An unaffected child can also be homozygous dominant.
